name: tokenwise-vscode
description: Task-aware code context pruning for AI workflows using SWE-Pruner.

tokenWise.defaultThreshold.description: Default pruning threshold used in requests.

tokenWise.autoOpenResultPanel.description: Open TokenWise result panel automatically after each prune.

tokenWise.enableCarbonEstimation.description: Estimate before/after carbon impact for each prune result.

tokenWise.carbonEstimatorMode.description: Use backend estimate-carbon endpoint (remote) or built-in estimator (local).

tokenWise.targetModelName.description: Target LLM family used for energy and carbon estimation.

tokenWise.targetModelSizeB.description: Target model size in billions of parameters.

tokenWise.targetGpuType.description: GPU type assumption used for SEAL prompt-level estimation.

tokenWise.targetMmluProScore.description: Optional MMLU-Pro score override for the selected model.

tokenWise.targetBbhScore.description: Optional BBH score override for the selected model.

tokenWise.expectedOutputTokens.description: Expected output token count used in prompt-level estimation.

tokenWise.latencyPerInputTokenMs.description: Estimated prefill latency per input token in milliseconds.

tokenWise.latencyPerOutputTokenMs.description: Estimated decode latency per output token in milliseconds.

tokenWise.carbonIntensityGPerKwh.description: Carbon intensity in grams CO2 per kWh for region-aware conversion.
